name: Star
description: Star is the first of the leadership ranks. The focus shifts from foundational skills to activity in the troop, merit badges, service and positions of responsibility.

provenance.notes: Topic outline drafted from maintainer familiarity with the Scouts BSA rank requirements (the structure introduced in 2016 and revised since) and cross-referenced with secondary sources found by web search. Official rank requirements could not be reached from the build environment. Requirement numbering for the later ranks has shifted over time; confirm against the current official text.

references.label: Wikipedia: Ranks in Scouts BSA (secondary source)

requirements.title: Active participation
requirements.summary: Being active in your troop for the required time as a First Class Scout.

requirements.title: Scout spirit
requirements.summary: Showing Scout spirit by living the Scout Oath and Scout Law.

requirements.title: Merit badges
requirements.summary: Earning the required number of merit badges, some from the Eagle-required list.
requirements.note: The Eagle-required list was reported to change in 2026. Confirm which badges count with your unit leader.

requirements.title: Service
requirements.summary: Taking part in approved service, including conservation-related service.

requirements.title: Position of responsibility
requirements.summary: Serving actively in a troop position of responsibility for the required time.

requirements.title: Personal safety
requirements.summary: Personal-safety exercises completed with a parent or guardian.
requirements.note: This requirement has changed in recent years (older versions referred to the Cyber Chip and a parent’s guide to child-abuse prevention; newer materials refer to personal safety awareness training). Use the current official wording.

requirements.title: Scoutmaster conference
requirements.summary: Taking part in a Scoutmaster conference.

requirements.title: Board of review
requirements.summary: Completing a board of review for the rank.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

requirements.title: Active participation
requirements.summary: Being active in your troop for the required time as a First Class Scout.

requirements.title: Scout spirit
requirements.summary: Living the Scout Oath and Law and explaining how you have done your duty to God.

requirements.title: Merit badges
requirements.summary: Earning six merit badges, including four from the Eagle-required list.

requirements.title: Service
requirements.summary: Six hours of approved service, including conservation-related service.

requirements.title: Position of responsibility
requirements.summary: Serving actively in an approved troop position, or carrying out an approved leadership project, for the required time.
requirements.note: Assistant patrol leader is not an approved position for Star, Life or Eagle.

requirements.title: Personal safety
requirements.summary: Personal-safety exercises with a parent or guardian.

children.title: Parent’s guide exercises
children.summary: Completing the exercises in the parent’s guide to child-abuse prevention with a parent or guardian.

children.title: Personal safety awareness videos
children.summary: Viewing the personal safety awareness videos with a parent’s or guardian’s permission.

requirements.title: Scoutmaster conference
requirements.summary: Taking part in a Scoutmaster conference.

requirements.title: Board of review
requirements.summary: Completing a board of review for the rank.
